claim_boundary: This unit only removes an operational obstacle for an independent evaluator. Even a valid detached signature is not accepted production evidence until the independent registry, fresh challenge, disclosure, request binding, ledger audit, criterion quorum, and strict claim gate all pass.
evidence_needed: focused round-trip proves emitted bytes equal ExternalAttestation.payload_bytes()
mismatched signature, mutated statement, embedded signature, unknown fields, missing fields, noncanonical keys, and forbidden nested secret keys fail closed
CLI failure produces no output artifact
CLI and API never accept a private key or mutate verifier registry/ledger
full relevant regression, compile validation, exact-head remote CI, unchanged-head and main readback before unit PASS
expected_outputs: payload command that writes exact canonical public bytes and labels them unsigned/non-evidence
finalize command that verifies a detached Ed25519 signature and atomically writes a signed attestation only on success
public API helpers for prepare/finalize with strict statement schema and recursive forbidden-secret-key rejection
documentation of the external signing workflow and the unchanged claim boundary
durable native O Run records for Execute then Task Evaluate
goal: Implement a secret-free detached-signature packaging boundary for ExternalAttestation: emit the exact canonical bytes an independent evaluator signs, accept only an externally generated Ed25519 signature plus public key, fail closed before output on malformed, secret-bearing, or mismatched statements, and preserve ledger audit plus AGI claim false as separate later gates.
inputs: ExternalAttestation.payload() canonicalization and existing Ed25519 verification
evidence/external_ledger.json and evidence/external_verifiers.json as negative evidence only
success_conditions: No private/signing key parameter or private material enters the repository process.
Output bytes are deterministic and exactly those covered by the detached signature.
Any validation or signature failure leaves the requested output absent or unchanged.
Finalization alone cannot register a verifier, append ledger evidence, satisfy audit, or set AGI true.
Exact-head CI and remote readback pass without weakening any strict gate.
